templateModal.title: Suspension Templates
templateModal.description: Select a template to prefill the reason and suggested duration.

templates.name: Conduct Detrimental
templates.reason: Conduct detrimental to the team, including behavior that disrupted team operations or damaged the organization.

templates.name: Insubordination
templates.reason: Repeated refusal to follow reasonable instructions from coaches, team officials, or league personnel.

templates.name: Missed Team Activities
templates.reason: Unexcused absence from a required practice, meeting, shootaround, treatment session, or team event.

templates.name: Repeated Absence
templates.reason: Multiple unexcused absences or repeated failure to report to the team as scheduled.

templates.name: Public Misconduct
templates.reason: Public behavior that brought the player, team, or league into disrepute.

templates.name: Social Media Misconduct
templates.reason: Inappropriate, threatening, or harmful social-media activity that violated team or league conduct standards.

templates.name: Harassment / Bullying
templates.reason: Harassment, bullying, or repeated abusive conduct toward a teammate, employee, official, or other league participant.

templates.name: Discriminatory Conduct
templates.reason: Discriminatory remarks or conduct that violated league standards for workplace and public behavior.

templates.name: Referee Abuse
templates.reason: Abusive, threatening, or aggressive behavior toward a game official beyond normal on-court dissent.

templates.name: Dangerous Play
templates.reason: A reckless or excessively dangerous basketball act that created a substantial risk of injury.

templates.name: On-Court Fight
templates.reason: Initiating or significantly escalating a physical altercation during a game.

templates.name: Bench-Clearing Incident
templates.reason: Leaving the bench area and participating in or escalating an on-court altercation.

templates.name: Fan Confrontation
templates.reason: Aggressive physical or verbal confrontation with a spectator before, during, or after a game.

templates.name: Entered the Stands
templates.reason: Entering the spectator area and engaging in a physical confrontation with fans.

templates.name: Teammate Assault
templates.reason: Physically attacking or seriously attempting to injure a teammate during a team activity.

templates.name: Coach / Staff Assault
templates.reason: Threatening, choking, striking, or otherwise physically attacking a coach or team employee.

templates.name: Threats / Intimidation
templates.reason: Serious threats, intimidation, or coercive behavior directed at a teammate, coach, employee, official, or witness.

templates.name: Weapon at Facility
templates.reason: Possessing, storing, displaying, or threatening another person with a weapon at a team or league facility.

templates.name: Firearm Display
templates.reason: Publicly displaying a firearm in a manner that violated league conduct and safety standards.

templates.name: Domestic Violence
templates.reason: A substantiated domestic-violence incident or related criminal disposition requiring league discipline.

templates.name: Criminal Assault
templates.reason: A serious off-court assault or violent criminal incident supported by an investigation, plea, or conviction.

templates.name: Investigation Noncompliance
templates.reason: Refusal to cooperate with a team or league investigation, including withholding information or ignoring directives.

templates.name: Unauthorized Gambling
templates.reason: Unauthorized sports wagering or gambling-related activity that created a conflict with league integrity rules.

templates.name: Inside Information Leak
templates.reason: Providing confidential team, player, injury, or strategy information for gambling or improper competitive use.

templates.name: PED Positive Test
templates.reason: A confirmed positive test for a prohibited performance-enhancing substance.

templates.name: Substance Abuse Violation
templates.reason: Violation of the league substance-abuse policy involving a prohibited drug or repeated policy offense.

templates.name: Treatment Noncompliance
templates.reason: Failure to complete required counseling, rehabilitation, treatment, or return-to-play conditions.

templates.name: Major Team Policy Violation
templates.reason: A serious violation of internal team policy requiring an extended suspension after an organizational investigation.
